test_title: PYST 17: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.**

I ______ (**itemize**) the work that will have to be done.
solution: The correct answer is **"enumerate."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Itemize"** means to make a list of all the separate items in something. (किसी वस्‍तु से संबंधित अलग-अलग मदों की सूची बनाना, मदवार देना) • **Example**: *We asked for an **itemized**__ bill, listing all our phone calls and how long they were.* • **"Enumerate" **is the synonym for **"Itemize."** • The word 'enumerate' means to list or mention items one by one. (गणन करना, एक-एक कर वस्‍तुओं का नाम बताना) __ • **Example**:* I will **enumerate**__ all the tasks that need to be completed before the project deadline.* • The correct answer is Option 2. **Correct sentence**:* **I __**enumerate**__ the work that will have to be done.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1) impart** means to give or convey information. (अन्‍य व्‍यक्तियों को जानकारी पहुँचाना, ज्ञान प्रदान करना) • **Option 3) conceal** means to hide or keep something secret. ((किसी से कुछ) छिपाना; गुप्‍त रखना) • **Option 4) assess** means to evaluate or judge something. (राय बनाना, आँकना) 30:Ta0c, The correct answer is **"BADCE". **
